Class GeoAgent

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.GeoAgent
public class GeoAgent extends Object
An agent of a GeoAgentModel: a geographic position (longitude and latitude in degrees, WGS84), a color (e.g., "#d62728", null: the color of the model), a size (the radius of the point in pixels, 0: the size of the model), an optional label, an altitude and a heading (for the 3D shapes on the WorldWind globe). Subclasses add their own fields and methods.
